go-jsonschema generate --schema schema.json --out ./model --package model --type Tags

exec go test -count=1 ./model

-- schema.json --
{
  "type": "array",
  "items": {"type": "string"}
}
-- go.mod --
module example.com/tagspkg

go 1.26
-- model/model_test.go --
package model

import (
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"testing"
)

func TestTags_RoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	in := []byte(`["a","b","c"]`)
	var tags Tags
	if err := json.Unmarshal(in, &tags); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: %v", err)
	}
	if len(tags) != 3 || tags[0] != "a" || tags[2] != "c" {
		t.Errorf("got %#v, want [a b c]", tags)
	}
	out, err := json.Marshal(tags)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Marshal: %v", err)
	}
	if string(out) != `["a","b","c"]` {
		t.Errorf("Marshal = %s, want %s", out, `["a","b","c"]`)
	}
}

func TestTags_NonStringElement(t *testing.T) {
	var tags Tags
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`[1]`), &tags); err == nil {
		t.Fatalf("Unmarshal: err = nil, want type error")
	}
}
